claims.content: C2 JU
The C2 JU has detected or initiated a track/point and assigned it a Track Number (TN) from its allocated block, thereby establishing Reporting Responsibility (R²) for the track.
A remote track report containing identity data (such as Environment, Identity, or Platform fields) has been received by the C2 JU via the interface.
The C2 JU possesses locally held surveillance data or track information against which the remote identity data can be compared.
A C2 JU receives a remote track report containing identity data that differs from its locally held identity data for the same track.

trigger.raw_text: A C2 JU receives a remote track report containing identity data that differs from its locally held identity data for the same track.

claims.content: If a correlation test fails because two tracks have an Identity (ID) difference that constitutes a conflict, automatic correlation is inhibited. The operator shall be alerted to resolve the conflict manually.
If conflicting IDs are the only restriction preventing correlation, the operator is alerted and may choose to change the local ID or Exercise Indicator to allow automatic correlation.

If conflicting IDs are the only restriction preventing correlation, the operator may instead transmit an ID Difference Report, allowing automatic correlation if the remote ID or Exercise Indicator is changed.
If a track's locally held Environment/Category differs from the received Environment/Category, the operator shall be alerted for manual resolution.
Exercise Indicator conflicts shall be resolved prior to ID or Identity Amplifying Descriptor Conflict resolution.
Identity Amplifying Descriptor conflicts are processed in the same manner as ID conflicts.
If the local data and received data differ as to whether the TN is assigned to a point or to a track, the operator shall be alerted.
